blueprint.originalBassIdentity: Upright bass, octave-change -1. Bar 1 rests. From bar 2 the bass takes the chord roots, then holds F through bars 18–25 except the rests inside that span. Bar 26 is Ab, 27–28 F. CBV is no-change.
strongestPassages: No listening rank. The leadsheet’s own recurrence is A against A′ (bars 1–9 and 10–17) and B against B′ (18–21 and 22–25). Section C, bars 26–29, is the only close: Dbmaj7, Bb7, Fmaj7, Fmaj7, ending on written C5.
A–H are inventoried, including E-V3.0. E V2.0 is not the E source.
blueprint.harmonicJourney: Fmaj7#11, Ebmaj7#5, Dbmaj7, Bmaj7, Bbm9, Abmaj7, Gbmaj7, Emaj7, then that chain again from bar 10. Bars 18–25 alternate Gmaj7/F and Ebmaj7/F. Bars 26–29: Dbmaj7, Bb7, Fmaj7, Fmaj7.
blueprint.contrapuntalOpportunities: The leadsheet guitar is a single line. A second voice is not written. The F pedal under B and B′ is the clearest place a guitar inner voice could answer the bass without leaving the printed harmony.
blueprint.dramaticClimax: Not auditioned. No dynamic peak is identified here. Section C is the printed closing area, not a claimed climax.
blueprint.thematicReturn: Bar 29 returns to written C5, the pitch that opens bar 1, over Fmaj7.
